debug_level.description: Debug verbosity level: 0 = silent, 1 = minimal, 2–3 = detailed, 4+ = very verbose.

log_file_path.description: Absolute path to the main log file.

log_max_files.description: Number of rotated log files to keep.

log_file_size_mb.description: Maximum size (in MB) of each log file before rotation. Set to 0 to disable size-based rotation.

ifaces.description: List of network interfaces to use for iSCSI offload traffic (e.g., ['eth1', 'eth2']). Leave empty to auto-detect offload-capable interfaces. Note: The iscsiuio configuration typically expects a single comma-separated string for the Ifaces directive, or specific formatting depending on the version. This list is joined with commas for the directive.

tcp_checksum_offload.description: Enable hardware TCP checksum offload for improved throughput.

tcp_seg_offload.description: Enable TCP segmentation offload (TSO) to reduce CPU load.

lro.description: Enable large receive offload (LRO) to coalesce incoming packets.

extra_modparams.description: Additional kernel module parameters as 'key=value' strings (e.g., ['ql4xdisablesrst=1', 'ql4xmaxlpivalue=256']). These are passed to the kernel module loading or configuration, not the iscsiuio daemon config directly in the same way, but preserved as requested for offload context if applicable to the specific driver load path.
